typed_core.why: coverage/recency

typed_core.name: withdrawal_or_liquidation_terms
typed_core.why: AS-11 — 'flag if terms restrict use'; the restriction/penalty text the rule judges

typed_core.name: gross_distribution_amount

typed_core.name: net_distribution_amount
typed_core.why: processor/income — actual funds received

typed_core.name: distribution_frequency
typed_core.why: disambiguator — monthly annuity vs one-time lump sum changes how gross/net are read

typed_core.name: distribution_date_or_schedule
typed_core.why: processor — when distributions occur

typed_core.name: year_to_date_distributions
typed_core.why: processor/income continuity — annualization cross-check (CONDITIONAL)

typed_core.name: required_minimum_distribution_indicator
typed_core.why: disambiguator — RMD (mandatory) vs discretionary distribution affects durability

typed_core.name: fixed_period_or_lifetime_indicator

typed_core.name: scheduled_end_date
typed_core.why: processor — when a fixed-period distribution ends (3-year-continuance test); durability signal

encoding_variations: Balance labels — the full value appears as 'Ending Balance', 'Total Value', 'Account Balance', 'Vested Balance', or 'Total Vested'; total_balance vs vested_balance must be kept separate (do NOT assume equal — existing prompt already enforces this)
Vesting — stated as a vested dollar amount, a vested percentage ('60% vested'), or a full vesting schedule table; capture the dollar figure in vested_balance and the percent in vested_percentage
Plan type — '401(k)', 'Traditional IRA', 'Roth IRA', '403(b)', 'Defined Benefit Pension', 'Annuity'; degrades from enum

Distribution vs balance statement — a retiree statement may be draw-down (shows distributions + remaining balance) or accumulation (shows balance only); fields absent for one form are null, never fabricated
Restriction/penalty prose — early-withdrawal penalty, loan-outstanding, or plan-lock language is free text; withdrawal_or_liquidation_terms captures it verbatim for AS-11 to judge

open_questions.q: total_balance vs catalog ending_balance/remaining_available_balance — for an accumulation statement these coincide; for a draw-down statement remaining_available_balance < total_balance
options: keep total_balance and remaining_available_balance as distinct
open_questions.recommendation: keep total_balance (full value, AS-3/AS-4) AND remaining_available_balance (accessible-after-restriction, AS-11) as distinct — confirm which the reserve calc should sum

open_questions.q: Holdings/positions nested list — many retirement/brokerage statements list positions with market values; no current rule reads them
options: flat-row holdings list if a future rule needs per-asset liquidity classification
open_questions.recommendation: none — account-level balances satisfy AS-3/AS-4/AS-11; if ever added, flat-row (item count can be large, 20+)

open_questions.q: Vesting representation — statements give vested $ and/or vested %
open_questions.recommendation: capture both; if only a schedule table is present, read the current-year vested figure and note the derivation in the snippet

open_questions.q: PII field name — plan_or_account_number_masked vs the registered account_number_masked
open_questions.recommendation: register the new name in _PII_FIELDS (pre_masked=true) rather than renaming, to avoid breaking the existing extractor's field GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: Is this an asset or income document? Today's 3 rules are all Assets, but the catalog CORE set is distribution/income-heavy
open_questions.recommendation: the schema serve both (done here); confirm no income rule is silently depending on the catch-all today

notes: Two balances matter and are separate: total_balance (full account) and vested_balance (owned/accessible). If only one balance is shown with no vesting language, fill total_balance and leave vested_balance null — do NOT assume they are equal.
Subtract nothing in the extractor: capture outstanding_loan_balance and withdrawal_or_liquidation_terms as read; the engine (AS-11) computes the usable portion.

This document can serve as both an asset (reserves — the active rules) and income (distributions); the distribution fields are captured even though today's rules are asset rules, so a future income rule is a schema no-op.
distribution_frequency, plan_type, fixed_period_or_lifetime_indicator, and required_minimum_distribution_indicator have enum_values null — pass through the stated value and normalize in the prompt.

plan_or_account_number_masked needs its own _PII_FIELDS registration (pre_masked=true); the registry today holds account_number_masked, a different key, so this field would otherwise be treated as a plain string.

statement_period_start and statement_period_end reason_class were set to processor as a best guess: their 'coverage/continuity' and 'coverage/recency' whys cite no rule id and name no explicit reason_class.
